Hi! I'm blocked on SLOTPLAN-108 due to conflicting acceptance tests. The ticket says you have the design review notes on edge-case decisions. Can you clarify: should touching intervals produce empty intervals at the touch points, or should they produce no output?

Hi! For intersect_intervals, the design review decision was: intervals that only touch (e.g., (540, 600) and (600, 660)) have nothing in common. The result should never contain zero-length (t, t) entries. So intersect_intervals([(540, 600)], [(600, 660)]) == [].
